revisions.reason: The current sentence says the reader service itself failed and omits that its connection failed; the pinned call site is the connection-test error.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Falló la conexión con el servicio de lectura.

revisions.reason: The current infinitive reads as an instruction to check the service; the caller displays this while a connection check is running.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Lesedienst wird überprüft…

revisions.reason: “Servicio de lectores” can mean a service belonging to readers; the UI is checking the connected reader service, consistently named “servicio de lectura” elsewhere.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Comprobando el servicio de lectura…

revisions.reason: “Aplicación de lectores” is an awkward and ambiguous rendering of the compatible reader app used for each media type; this names an application for reading.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Para un artículo solicitado, SeerrNG también puede descargar los archivos disponibles directamente al dispositivo que ejecuta este navegador. Los audiolibros, los cómics y los números de revista requieren su propio formato de archivo y una aplicación de lectura compatible.

revisions.reason: The current title puts “الإنشاء” after the English product names and reads as a fragment about creation; this is a setup heading for Grimmory’s Komga API.
revisions.recommendedTarget: إعداد واجهة Komga API في Grimmory

revisions.reason: The source count is displayed with `#`. The Arabic `one` branch spells out “one” and the `two` branch relies on a dual noun; this keeps the count-driven values in the ICU marker and retains natural zero wording.
revisions.recommendedTarget: {count, plural, zero {لا توجد عناصر} one {# عنصر} two {# من العناصر} few {# عناصر} many {# عنصرًا} other {# عنصر}}

revisions.reason: The current participle “Vista previa encontrada” is ungrammatical as a sentence; the source reports what the preview found and that the final count is not confirmed.
revisions.recommendedTarget: La vista previa encontró {count} elementos; aún no se ha confirmado el recuento final.

revisions.reason: The current noun sequence “Estante de lector gestionado eliminado” is difficult to parse and can mean a reader’s shelf; the source reports that the managed reader shelf was removed.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Se eliminó el estante de lectura gestionado.

revisions.reason: “Estantes de lectores” suggests shelves belonging to reader users; these are shelves managed in the connected reader service.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Estantes de lectura gestionados por SeerrNG

revisions.reason: The current “estantes de lectores de SeerrNG” is ambiguous about whose shelves these are; the caller identifies SeerrNG-managed shelves in the reader service.
revisions.recommendedTarget: SeerrNG aún no ha creado ningún estante de lectura.

revisions.reason: The current “estantes de lectores” and “app de lectura” obscure that SeerrNG manages shelves inside the reader service; the caller distinguishes those service shelves from credentials.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Conecta una cuenta de administrador para que SeerrNG pueda previsualizar, crear y actualizar estantes de lectura. Las contraseñas se almacenan en la configuración protegida de la aplicación y nunca se devuelven por la API. Las credenciales de la aplicación de lectura y de OPDS permanecen separadas.

revisions.reason: The current value says “preferred reading” and omits the app selected by this field.
revisions.recommendedTarget: تطبيق القراءة المفضل

revisions.reason: “Legt die Sichtbarkeit fest” says the setting is determined, but the adjacent caller says it cannot be changed after creation; this states that the setting is locked.
revisions.recommendedTarget: BookOrbit sperrt die Sichtbarkeitseinstellung beim Erstellen eines SmartScope. Wenn die Kobo-Synchronisierung aktiviert ist, verwaltet SeerrNG außerdem eine reguläre Sammlung und gleicht deren Einträge alle 15 Minuten ab.

revisions.reason: “Estante de lector” reads as a shelf belonging to a reader; this is the action that creates a shelf in the reader service.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Crear estante de lectura

revisions.reason: “القاعدة المباشرة” does not express a live, automatically updated rule. The caller describes future matching books appearing without further action.
revisions.recommendedTarget: أنشئ هذه القاعدة الديناميكية على أي حال لكي تظهر الكتب المطابقة مستقبلًا تلقائيًا.

revisions.reason: “Regla en vivo” is a literal rendering; the caller makes clear that this rule updates so future matching books appear automatically.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Cree esta regla dinámica de todos modos para que los libros que coincidan en el futuro aparezcan automáticamente.

revisions.reason: “تجميع مباشر” reads as a direct/live grouping; the caller describes a rule-based grouping that stays current as the library changes.
revisions.recommendedTarget: سينشئ SeerrNG تجميعًا ديناميكيًا قائمًا على القواعد في خدمة القراءة لديك. وسيظل محدّثًا كلما تغيّرت تلك المكتبة؛ فهو لا ينسخ الملفات.

revisions.reason: “Agrupación en vivo” is a literal rendering; the source and caller describe a dynamic rule-based grouping that stays current as the reader library changes.
revisions.recommendedTarget: SeerrNG creará una agrupación dinámica basada en reglas en su servicio de lectura. Se mantiene actualizada a medida que cambia la biblioteca; no copia archivos.

revisions.reason: The source count is displayed with `#`. The Arabic `one` branch spells out “one” and the `two` branch relies on a dual noun; this keeps count-driven values in the ICU marker and retains natural zero wording.
revisions.recommendedTarget: {count, plural, zero {لا توجد تطابقات حالية} one {# تطابق حالي} two {# من التطابقات الحالية} few {# تطابقات حالية} many {# تطابقًا حاليًا} other {# تطابق حالي}}

revisions.reason: The current “لا يوجد كتب” has incorrect Arabic agreement; the source says no current books match the rule.
revisions.recommendedTarget: لا توجد كتب حالية تطابق هذه القاعدة.

revisions.reason: “Biblioteca del lector” may mean a person’s library; this is the connected reader service library being checked.
revisions.recommendedTarget: No se pudo comprobar la biblioteca de lectura.

revisions.reason: The current infinitive is an instruction; the pinned caller uses this label during an in-progress library check.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Bibliothek wird überprüft…

revisions.reason: “Estante del lector” suggests a reader-owned shelf; the caller is saving a managed shelf in the reader service.
revisions.recommendedTarget: No se pudo guardar el estante de lectura.

revisions.reason: The source refers to the rule-based grouping, while “grupo” is underspecified beside the other UI strings for reader shelves and groupings.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Mostrar esta agrupación a otros usuarios del servicio de lectura

revisions.reason: The current “القاعدة المباشرة” does not convey a rule that continuously updates with library matches.
revisions.recommendedTarget: مزامنة هذه القاعدة الديناميكية مع Kobo

revisions.reason: “Live-Regel” is an unnatural literal rendering here; the rule updates from changing library matches, so “dynamische Regel” preserves the behavior.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Diese dynamische Regel mit Kobo synchronisieren

revisions.reason: “Regla activa” loses the source’s live-updating behavior; nearby help explains that the rule is reconciled against the library every 15 minutes.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Sincronizar esta regla dinámica con Kobo

revisions.reason: The current “القاعدة المباشرة” loses the live, rule-updated behavior stated in the source and helper text; the replacement retains the 15-minute reconciliation and account-pairing instructions.
revisions.recommendedTarget: عند تفعيلها، ينشئ SeerrNG مجموعة BookOrbit مُدارة ويوائم عناصرها مع هذه القاعدة الديناميكية كل 15 دقيقة. اربط حساب Kobo في BookOrbit.

revisions.reason: “Live-Regel” is a literal, ambiguous rendering; the helper says SeerrNG periodically reconciles collection entries against the dynamic matching rule.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Wenn aktiviert, erstellt SeerrNG eine verwaltete BookOrbit-Sammlung und gleicht ihre Einträge alle 15 Minuten mit dieser dynamischen Regel ab. Verknüpfen Sie das Kobo-Konto in BookOrbit.

revisions.reason: “Regla activa” can mean merely enabled; the source describes a live rule that changes with library matches. This also keeps the 15-minute collection reconciliation.
revisions.recommendedTarget: Cuando se activa, SeerrNG crea una Colección de BookOrbit gestionada y reconcilia cada 15 minutos los elementos que la integran con esta regla dinámica. Asocia la cuenta de Kobo en BookOrbit.
